statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was billed
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The service is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient prior to initiating this level of care
